mapper.select: select role_id from system_user_role where user_id = #{userId} and deleted = '0'

SELECT u.username FROM system_users u JOIN system_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN system_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.code = #{roleCode} AND u.deleted = '0' AND ur.deleted = '0' AND r.deleted = '0' ORDER BY u.id
